title: Count Even and Odd
description: Given an array of $n$ integers, count how many of them are even and how many are odd.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print two space-separated integers — the count of even numbers and the count of odd numbers.
